environment.description: Deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) with a Lua filter that inspects WebSocket text frames and applies path canonicalization before forwarding. The upstream response path has an Envoy ext_proc filter that adds response headers including a strict Content-Security-Policy. The CSP header is: script-src 'nonce-{random}' 'strict-dynamic'; style-src 'self'; default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'. The nonce rotates per-connection. Additionally, the pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the container filesystem uses an overlayfs with a read-only lower layer where /var/app/data is a tmpfs mount with the 'nosymfollow' mount option (available in kernel 5.10+), preventing the kernel from following symlinks during path resolution on that mount point.

config.proxy: Envoy 1.28 sidecar with Lua frame inspection and ext_proc response filter
config.filesystem: overlayfs, /var/app/data mounted as tmpfs with 'nosymfollow' option
